files.README.md:
# Dispatch platform deploy workspace

Layout:
- deploy/defaults.yaml - fleet baselines for every service
- deploy/local.yaml - site-local tuning, layered after the baselines
- deploy/<env>/<service>.yaml - the environment overlay, layered last

The deployer brings an environment up from the bottom of that list upward,
so the environment overlay carries the final value for any key it sets.
deploy/prod/dispatch-router.yaml is the reference overlay the platform team
reviews whenever a new environment is added.
files.deploy/defaults.yaml:
# Fleet baselines applied to every service before the local file.
dispatch-router:
  hold_queue_depth: 120
  dispatch_timeout_seconds: 40
  reject_retry_limit: 4
files.deploy/local.yaml:
# Site-local tuning, layered after the baselines.
include: defaults.yaml
dispatch-router:
  hold_queue_depth: 200
  dispatch_timeout_seconds: 35
files.deploy/staging/dispatch-router.yaml:
service: dispatch-router
environment: staging
hold_queue_depth: 350
dispatch_timeout_seconds: 30
files.deploy/prod/dispatch-router.yaml:
# dispatch-router overlay - production (canonical reference)
#
# This overlay is the one every new environment is compared against. The
# dispatch desk reviews it each release; the queue depth below was raised
# after the 2026-07 congestion review so the morning peak would stop
# shedding load.
service: dispatch-router
environment: production
hold_queue_depth: 900
dispatch_timeout_seconds: 25
reject_retry_limit: 6
dead_letter_enabled: true
